ModMetaData.name: RimWorld: SCP Foundation — Ouroboros
ModMetaData.author: SCP MOD contributors
ModMetaData.description: Community-made SCP Foundation mod for RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7 (1.7 gameplay testing in progress), with containment, research, equipment, factions and a complete Ouroboros quest arc compatible with vanilla storytellers. Core and the separate Harmony mod are required; individual content can use installed DLC. Based on SCP Wiki works under CC BY-SA 3.0, including Ouroboros by djkaktus and TwistedGears: https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/ouroboros.
